gen-gf-iansui-fs-erode: Pencil-steady diagonals as thick as the uprights, with flared curve ends that stay apart, mark Iansui as plainly hand-drawn. Erode, a serif, swells like carved stone, lending the pair its dignity.
gen-gf-iansui-fs-fira-sans: Fira Sans stands tall, its strokes uniform from start to finish. Iansui's hand-drawn, flared curves sit lower and softer above it, and that friendly wobble against crisp uniformity is the whole appeal.
gen-gf-iansui-fs-public-sans: Iansui's hand-drawn strokes keep a constant width, like bent wire, with gently flared curve ends. Public Sans lays down a hefty, trustworthy lowercase with broad counters, so extended reading feels steady and unhurried.
gen-gf-iansui-fs-supreme: Supreme runs a thick, heavy-looking strip of text, letters held open rather than curled shut. Supreme keeps extended reading crisp and weighty, beneath Iansui's hand-drawn line that never swells or tapers.
gen-gf-iansui-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Iansui writes with flared, hand-drawn curves and diagonals as thick as its uprights, friendly and personal in every line. BhuTuka Expanded One slows the pace to a leisurely stroll beneath that handwriting.
gen-gf-iansui-gf-hepta-slab: Friendly and hand-drawn, Iansui keeps its diagonals as thick as its uprights, with curve ends flaring gently. Hepta Slab stretches out beneath it, a serif with bent-paperclip strokes and counters that breathe.
gen-gf-iansui-gf-kiwi-maru: Soft, handwritten, unhurried: Iansui flares its curve ends gently while its diagonals match its uprights in thickness. Kiwi Maru adds generous letterspacing and ring-like o shapes with constant walls, and that sturdiness is the real strength.
gen-gf-iansui-gf-science-gothic: Diagonals as thick as the uprights give Iansui a hand-drawn, friendly line, its curve ends flaring gently. Science Gothic reads one letter at a time, its stroke ends set far apart and every stroke uniform.
gen-gf-iansui-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: Iansui's curve ends flare gently and never touch, giving its hand-drawn line a personal, friendly warmth throughout. Stint Ultra Expanded lets each character float apart, wide, open and authoritative.
gen-gf-iansui-gf-syncopate: Syncopate spaces its open letters out like rungs on a rope ladder. Iansui's friendly, flared hand-drawn curves against that technical-pen steadiness make a mechanical-versus-personal tension, and it is the whole charm.
